hook: A 41-storey apartment tower of 2002 that carries the reattached façade of the demolished Hotel Jessie on its Jessie Street side.

historic_survey.status_code_meaning: California Historical Resource Status Codes: a 1 or 2 means listed or formally determined eligible, a 3 means the survey judged it eligible, a 4 that it may become eligible, a 6 that it was found ineligible, and a 7 that it was not evaluated.

historical_record.description: The façade of the demolished Hotel Jessie was reattached to this building's Jessie Street elevation as a condition of the project.
